18044-wine-women-and-song-mediaeval-lati.title: With An Essay
18044-wine-women-and-song-mediaeval-lati.creator: Unknown
18044-wine-women-and-song-mediaeval-lati.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. sunk in the slough of ignorant, perversely subtle disputation upon subjects destitute of actuality. Theological fanaticism has extinguished liberal studies and the gropings of the reason after truth in positive experience. Society lies prostrate under the heel of tyrannous orthodoxy. We discern men in masses, aggregations, classes, guilds--everywhere the genus and the species of humanity, rarely and by luminous exception individuals and persons. Universal ideals of Church and Empire clog and confuse the nascent nationalities.

35281-the-joyous-story-of-toto.title: Toto.
35281-the-joyous-story-of-toto.creator: Laura E. Richards.
35281-the-joyous-story-of-toto.description: A book by Laura E. Richards.. His grandmother was the best grandmother in the world, I have been given to understand, though that is saying a great deal, to be sure. She was certainly a very good, kind old body; and she had pretty silver curls and pink cheeks, as every grandmother should have. There was only one trouble about her; but that was a very serious one,—she was blind.

arxiv-2007-15498.title: A least-squares Galerkin gradient recovery method for fully nonlinear elliptic equations
arxiv-2007-15498.creator: Omar Lakkis and Amireh Mousavi
arxiv-2007-15498.description: Abstract . We propose a least squares Galerkin based gradient recovery to approximate Dirichlet problems for strong solutions of linear elliptic problems in nondivergence form and corresponding a priori and a posteriori error bounds. This approach is used to tackle fully nonlinear elliptic problems, e.g., Monge–Ampère, Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman, using the smooth (vanilla) and the semismooth Newton linearization.

arxiv-2106-15955.title: Regularity of the distance function from arbitrary closed sets
arxiv-2106-15955.creator: Sławomir Kolasiński, Mario Santilli
arxiv-2106-15955.description: Abstract We investigate the distance function 𝜹 K ϕ \bm{\delta}_{K}^{\phi} from an arbitrary closed subset K K of a finite-dimensional Banach space ( 𝐑 n , ϕ ) (\mathbf{R}^{n},\phi) , equipped with a uniformly convex 𝒞 2 \mathscr{C}^{2} -norm ϕ \phi .

arxiv-2312-05421.title: Architecture Decisions in Quantum Software Systems: An Empirical Study on Stack Exchange and GitHub Journal: Information and Software Technology
arxiv-2312-05421.creator: Mst Shamima Aktar, Peng Liang, Muhammad Waseem, Amjed Tahir, Aakash Ahmad, Beiqi Zhang, Zengyang Li
arxiv-2312-05421.description: Abstract Context : Quantum computing provides a new dimension in computation, utilizing the principles of quantum mechanics to potentially solve complex problems that are currently intractable for classical computers. However, little research has been conducted about the architecture decisions made in quantum software development, which have a significant influence on the functionality, performance, scalability, and reliability of these systems.

arxiv-2407-13672.title: Systematic input scheme of many-boson Hamiltonians with applications to the two-dimensional ϕ 4 \phi^{4} theory
arxiv-2407-13672.creator: Weijie Du, James P. Vary
arxiv-2407-13672.description: Abstract We develop a novel, systematic input scheme for many-boson Hamiltonians in order to solve field theory problems within the light-front Hamiltonian formalism via quantum computing. We present our discussion of this input scheme based on the light-front Hamiltonian of the two-dimensional ϕ 4 \phi^{4} theory.

arxiv-2409-09017.title: Invariant Metrics on Nilpotent Lie algebras
arxiv-2409-09017.creator: R. García-Delgado
arxiv-2409-09017.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by R. García-Delgado. We state criteria for a nilpotent Lie algebra 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} to admit an invariant metric. We use that 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} possesses two canonical abelian ideals 𝔦 ⁡ ( 𝔤 ) ⊂ 𝔍 ⁡ ( 𝔤 ) \mathfrak{i}(\mathfrak{g})\subset\mathfrak{J}(\mathfrak{g}) to decompose the underlying vector space of 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} and then we state sufficient conditions for 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} to admit an invariant metric.

arxiv-2410-06696.title: An epidemic model on a network having two group structures with tunable overlap
arxiv-2410-06696.creator: Frank Ball, Tom Britton, Peter Neal
arxiv-2410-06696.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Frank Ball, Tom Britton, Peter Neal. A network epidemic model is studied. The underlying social network has two different types of group structures, households and workplaces, such that each individual belongs to exactly one household and one workplace.

arxiv-2410-21501.title: SandboxAQ’s submission to MRL 2024 Shared Task on Multi-lingual Multi-task Information Retrieval
arxiv-2410-21501.creator: Isidora Chara Tourni Sayontan Ghosh isidora.tourni@gmail.com sayontan.ghosh@gmail.com Brenda Miao Constantijn van der Poel brenda.miao@gmail.com constantijn@sandboxquantum.com
arxiv-2410-21501.description: Abstract This paper explores the problems of Question Answering (QA) and Named Entity Recognition (NER) in five diverse languages. We tested five Large Language Models with various prompting methods, including zero-shot, chain-of-thought reasoning, and translation techniques. Our results show that while some models consistently outperform others, their effectiveness varies significantly across tasks and languages.

arxiv-2412-15694.title: Multiplicative convolution and double shuffle relations: convolution
arxiv-2412-15694.creator: Nikita Markarian
arxiv-2412-15694.description: Abstract . This is the first of two parts of a project devoted to a geometric interpretation of the Deligne–Terasoma approach to regularized double shuffle relations. The central fact of this approach is the isomorphism between vanishing cycles of multiplicative convolution of certain perverse sheaves and the tensor product of vanishing cycles, which may be written in two different ways.

arxiv-2504-00380.title: Hierarchical Flow Diffusion for Efficient Frame Interpolation
arxiv-2504-00380.creator: Yang Hai , Guo Wang , Tan Su , Wenjie Jiang , Yinlin Hu
arxiv-2504-00380.description: Abstract Most recent diffusion-based methods still show a large gap compared to non-diffusion methods for video frame interpolation, in both accuracy and efficiency. Most of them formulate the problem as a denoising procedure in latent space directly, which is less effective caused by the large latent space.

arxiv-2504-20584.title: Hydra: Marker-Free RGB-D Hand-Eye Calibration
arxiv-2504-20584.creator: Martin Huber, Huanyu Tian, Christopher E. Mower, Lucas-Raphael Müller, Sébastien Ourselin, Christos Bergeles, Tom Vercauteren
arxiv-2504-20584.description: Abstract This work presents an RGB-D imaging-based approach to marker-free hand-eye calibration using a novel implementation of the iterative closest point (ICP)algorithm with a robust point-to-plane (PTP)objective formulated on a Lie algebra. Its applicability is demonstrated through comprehensive experiments using three well known serial manipulators and two RGB-D cameras.

arxiv-2505-11192.title: FALCON: False-Negative Aware Learning of Contrastive Negatives in Vision-Language Pretraining
arxiv-2505-11192.creator: Myunsoo Kim, Seong-Woong Shim, Byung-Jun Lee
arxiv-2505-11192.description: Abstract False negatives pose a critical challenge in vision-language pretraining (VLP) due to the many-to-many correspondence between images and texts in large-scale datasets. These false negatives introduce conflicting supervision signals that degrade the learned embedding space and diminish the effectiveness of hard negative sampling.

arxiv-2505-12504.title: CPGD: Toward Stable Rule-based Reinforcement Learning for Language Models
arxiv-2505-12504.creator: Zongkai Liu 1,2 Fanqing Meng 4* Lingxiao Du 3* Zhixiang Zhou 2* Chao Yu 1 † \dagger Wenqi Shao 2,3 † \dagger Qiaosheng Zhang 2,3 1 Sun Yat-Sen University 2 Shanghai Innovation Institute 3 Shanghai AI Laboratory 4 Shanghai Jiao Tong University
arxiv-2505-12504.description: Abstract Recent advances in rule-based reinforcement learning (RL) have significantly improved the reasoning capability of language models (LMs) with rule-based rewards. However, existing RL methods—such as GRPO, REINFORCE++, and RLOO—often suffer from training instability, where large policy updates and improper clipping can lead to training collapse.

arxiv-2509-06084.title: From KP-I Lump Solution to Travelling wave of 3D Gravity Capillary Water wave problem
arxiv-2509-06084.creator: Changfeng Gui, Shanfa Lai, Yong Liu, Juncheng Wei, Wen Yang
arxiv-2509-06084.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study the three-dimensional gravity-capillary water wave problem involving an irrotational, perfect fluid with gravity and surface tension. We focus on steady waves propagating uniformly in one direction. Assuming constant wave speed and water depth, we analyze the fluid’s velocity potential and boundary conditions.

britannica-1911-pheidias.title: Pheidias (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-pheidias.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-pheidias.description: Article 'Pheidias' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 21), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. According to Philochorus, as quoted by a scholiast on Aristophanes, he fled to Elis, where he made the great statue of Zeus for the Eleans, and was afterwards put to death by them. For several reasons the first of these tales is preferable. Plutarch gives in his life of Pericles a charming account of the vast artistic activity which went on at Athens while that statesman was in power.

pmc-10576800.creator: Xiaoliang Ba, Claire L Raisen, Olivier Restif, Lina Maria Cavaco, Carina Vingsbo Lundberg, Jean Y H Lee, Benjamin P Howden, Mette D Bartels, Birgit Strommenger, Ewan M Harrison, Anders Rhod Larsen, Mark A Holmes, Jesper Larsen
pmc-10576800.description: Global spread of multidrug-resistant, hospital-adapted Staphylococcus epidermidis lineages underscores the need for new therapeutic strategies. Here we show that many S. epidermidis isolates belonging to these lineages display cryptic susceptibility to penicillin/β-lactamase inhibitor combinations under in vitro conditions, despite carrying the methicillin resistance gene mecA. Using a mouse thigh model of S.

pmc-10690005.title: Evaluation of a pre-professional pathway program: perspectives of former students in the rural pre-medicine program at Selkirk College
pmc-10690005.creator: Sara McEwen, Jonathan Vanderhoek, Takaia Larsen
pmc-10690005.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundHaving a rural background is one of the most predictive factors in eventually having a rural practice, but people from rural areas face several barriers to post-secondary education. Pre-professional rural pathway initiatives are a potential solution.

pmc-10731546.title: The Implementation of a Virtual Emergency Department: Multimethods Study Guided by the RE-AIM (Reach, Effectiveness, Adoption, Implementation, and Maintenance) Framework
pmc-10731546.creator: Jennifer Shuldiner, Diya Srinivasan, Laura Desveaux, Justin N Hall, Amaryllis Mavragani, Raniah Aldekhyyel, Vishnunarayan Girishan Prabhu
pmc-10731546.description: BackgroundWhile the COVID-19 pandemic dramatically increased virtual care uptake across many health settings, it remains significantly underused in urgent care.ObjectiveThis study evaluated the implementation of a pilot virtual emergency department (VED) at an Ontario hospital that connected patients to emergency physicians through a web-based portal.

pmc-11482540.title: Obstructed Defecation Syndrome: Analysis of the Efficacy and Mid-Term Quality of Life of an Innovative Robotic Approach
pmc-11482540.creator: Mauro Cervigni, Andrea Fuschi, Andrea Morciano, Lorenzo Campanella, Antonio Carbone, Michele Carlo Schiavi, Stefano Restaino, Edward J Pavlik
pmc-11482540.description: Background: The goal of our research is to demonstrate how the combination of Rectal wall Plication (RP) and robotic Ventral Mesh Rectopexy (VMR) results in a safe and effective operation that provides superior outcomes for patients with Obstructed Defecation Syndrome (ODS).

pmc-11652763.title: Ambrosia (ragweed) pollen — A growing aeroallergen of concern in South Africa
pmc-11652763.creator: Dorra Gharbi, Dilys Berman, Frank H Neumann, Trevor Hill, Siyavuya Sidla, Sarel S Cillers, Jurgens Staats, Nanike Esterhuizen, Linus Ajikah, Moteng E Moseri, Lynne J Quick, Erin Hilmer, Andri Van Aardt, Juanette John, Rebecca Garland, Jemma Finch, Werner Hoek, Marion Bamford, Riaz Y Seedat, Ahmed I
pmc-11652763.description: BackgroundRagweed is an invasive, highly allergenic weed predicted to expand its habitat with warming global temperatures. Several Ambrosia species have been identified in South Africa for well over a century; however, its presence remained undetected by allergists and aerobiologists until the development of an extensive aerospora monitoring system across South African urban areas since 2019.

pmc-11770027.title: Analysis of artery injury types and clinical characteristics of patients with transcatheter angioembolization after percutaneous nephrolithotomy
pmc-11770027.creator: Xianghu Meng, Rong Cong, Yibo Hua, Zengjun Wang, Ninghong Song, Wei Yang, Rijin Song
pmc-11770027.description: BackgroundThere is no systematic classification of renal vascular injuries conducted for severe post-percutaneous nephrolithotomy (PCNL) bleeding.AimThe aim of the present study was to explore the various types of artery injury and clinical characteristics of patients who underwent transcatheter angioembolization (TAE) after PCNL.

pmc-12376974.title: An aluminum-based adsorbent/zeolite molecular sieve composite for the sorption of lithium in the salt lake
pmc-12376974.creator: Dawei Fang, Shilong Suo, Donglu Fu, Kunhao Liang, Jing Qiao, Zongren Song
pmc-12376974.description: In the context of the global energy transition, the efficient extraction of lithium resources has become a critical link in the new energy industry chain. Addressing challenges such as poor selectivity, low adsorption capacity, and environmental concerns in extracting lithium from salt lake brines, this study developed a novel aluminum-based adsorbent/zeolite molecular sieve composite adsorbent (LiAl-LDHs/ZSM-5).

pmc-12836531.title: An open-label phase Ib/II study of trastuzumab deruxtecan combined with nivolumab and CAPOX for HER2-low gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma
pmc-12836531.creator: Y. Aoki, I. Nakayama, Y. Komura, M. Wakabayashi, S. Fukuoka, H. Hara, H. Shoji, M. Furuta, K. Minashi, A. Sato, N. Fuse, N. Sakamoto, T. Kuwata, K. Shitara
pmc-12836531.description: BackgroundTrastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) is the standard of care for previously treated patients with HER2-positive metastatic gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (mGEA). Exploratory analyses of the DESTINY-Gastric01 trial suggested preliminary antitumor activity of T-DXd in HER2-low mGEA. Additionally, preclinical studies have reported a synergistic effect between T-DXd and anti-programmed cell death protein 1 antibodies.

pmc-13445983.title: Beyond the genetic code: orchestrating epigenetic and immune landscapes with multivalent mRNA-exosome vaccines
pmc-13445983.creator: Huiqin Bian, William Tse, Gang Huang, Shujun Liu
pmc-13445983.description: mRNA therapeutics are transitioning from transient anti-viral vaccines into precise cancer immunotherapies capable of orchestrating potent antigen-specific T-cell and humoral responses. However, therapeutic resistance within immunologically “cold” tumors remains a formidable barrier, necessitating multiaxial optimization across transcript architecture, neoantigen selection, delivery vector engineering, and tumor microenvironment (TME) reprogramming.

pmc-13682030.title: Efficacy of anterioposterior weight-shift training with visual biofeedback for step length asymmetry and functional mobility in chronic stroke: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13682030.creator: Jong Weon Lee, Yea Jin Jo, Yoon Su Baek, Seeun Kim, Jung Hoon Kim, Dae Hyun Kim, Jong Hyun Choi, Jong Bum Park, Deog Young Kim
pmc-13682030.description: BackgroundStep length asymmetry is a specific and persistent characteristic of hemiparetic gait in patients with chronic stroke, typically resulting from impaired weight bearing and reduced propulsive force on the paretic side. This asymmetry leads to reduced walking efficiency and an increased risk of musculoskeletal complications.
